## Data cleaning
```{r}
# outcome is whether a vaccine was received
data = process_data(filename = 'child_politics_refusals_covariates_05192025.csv.zip', 
                    time_var = 'time_to_refusal', 
                    filter_yr = 2000, 
                    filter_outcome_time = 7,
                    filter_engage_time = 1,
                    remove_after_4 = FALSE)

data$indic = as.numeric(data$indic)*100
data$year_num = as.numeric(data$year_num)
```

```{r}
nrow(data)
sum(data$indic/100)

# title: "Partisan Gap in Refusal Rate by Birth Year\n(Democrat-Republican)"
plot_year_disparity(data, 
                    party_baseline = "D",
                    outcome = "indic",
                    title = "", 
                    hist_title = "Number of Observations per Year",
                    ylab = "Estimated Gap in Refusal Rate\n(Percentage Points)",
                    labFalse = "No Refusal",
                    labTrue = "Refusal",
                    line_color = 'salmon',
                    hist_color = 'salmon')

ggsave(
  '~/afc-claire/code/figures/refusals.png',
  width = 7,
  height = 5)
```

```{r}
model_table = interaction_model(data, party_reference = 'D',
                                ref_year = 2000, outcome = 'indic', 
                                state_FE = FALSE, x = TRUE)

rownames(model_table) <- NULL
# Generate LaTeX table with kable
latex_out <- kable(model_table, 
      format = "latex", 
      caption = "Refusal Indicator", 
      booktabs = TRUE,  # For cleaner lines
      align = c("l"),
      escape = FALSE)  # Left-align the first column and right-align others
cat(latex_out)
```
